questions.question: Code X + Y: X is Y’s father; X - Y: X is Y’s mother; X @ Y: X is Y’s brother. Which expression puts A two generations above D but does NOT prove that A is D’s grandfather?
questions.explanation: A is the brother of D’s mother’s father B, so he is two generations above D without being D’s grandfather.

questions.question: An elder woman, Bimla, is the mother of a man, Chandan. Chandan is the father of Deepa; Deepa is the mother of Eklavya. What is Bimla’s relationship to Deepa?
questions.explanation: Use Deepa → father Chandan → mother Bimla; Eklavya lies beyond the requested path.

questions.question: A is mother of B; B is brother of C; C is father of D. Starting at D’s generation, which pair is definitely at levels +1 and +2 respectively?
questions.explanation: B shares C’s parental generation at +1; their mother A is at +2.

questions.question: Seven people H–N form one family. H is a man married to I. J is their only son. K is J’s sister. L, a woman, is a daughter-in-law of H. M and N are the son and daughter of J. Exactly two couples exist, and every child’s parents are married. Who is M’s mother?
questions.explanation: H’s only son is J, so daughter-in-law L is J’s wife and the stated married-parent rule makes her M’s mother.

questions.question: A man, Omkar, points to an elderly man: “My mother is his only child.” Which relationship is certain?

options.label: A
options.text: The man is Omkar’s paternal grandfather

options.label: D
options.text: The man is Omkar’s maternal grandfather

questions.explanation: The pointed man is the father of Omkar’s mother.

questions.question: X @ Y means X is Y’s son; X # Y means X is Y’s sister; X $ Y means X is Y’s father. For A @ B # C $ D, choose the shortest correct path from D to A.
questions.explanation: D’s father is C, C’s sister is B, and B’s son is A.

questions.question: A man, Farhan, is married to Zoya. Zoya’s mother is Sameera and her father is Khalid. Which pair gives Farhan’s mother-in-law and father-in-law in that order?
questions.explanation: His wife Zoya’s mother is Sameera and her father is Khalid.

questions.question: A verbal tree has A (female) married to B (male). Their son C marries D (female), and daughter E marries F (male). C–D have son G; E–F have daughter H. Which pair is connected only through marriage in the stated tree, with neither a parent–child nor a sibling link?
questions.explanation: E and F are spouses; the other pairs are parent–child or siblings.

questions.question: Three sisters each have two daughters. Their mother has no other children. Counting only these named generations, how many females are simultaneously a daughter and a mother of someone in the group?
questions.explanation: Each of the three sisters is a daughter of the eldest woman and a mother of two girls; no other overlap is given.

questions.question: Question: Who is T’s father? I. R is T’s father. II. R is a man, S is T’s mother, and R and S are T’s only parents. Choose the sufficiency assessment.
questions.explanation: I names the father directly; II independently makes R the male parent of T.

questions.question: X + Y means X is Y’s mother; X - Y means X is Y’s son; X * Y means X is Y’s sister. Which expression establishes that P is Q’s granddaughter through a daughter?
questions.explanation: Q is R’s mother, R is P’s mother, and P * S proves P is female.

questions.question: A man has a daughter and a son. His daughter’s child X and his son’s child Y have unspecified genders. Which statement is certain?

options.label: A
options.text: He is maternal grandfather to both

options.label: B
options.text: He is X’s maternal and Y’s paternal grandfather

options.label: C
options.text: X is his grandson and Y his granddaughter

questions.explanation: The parent’s gender fixes the maternal or paternal branch even when the grandchildren’s genders are unknown.

questions.question: A man, Suraj, has a daughter Mita. Mita’s brother Nikhil has a son, Ojas. Which person lies between Suraj and Ojas on their direct descent line?
questions.explanation: Nikhil shares father Suraj with Mita; the direct line is Suraj → Nikhil → Ojas.

questions.question: Use X @ Y for X is Y’s mother, X # Y for X is Y’s daughter, X $ Y for X is Y’s brother. In A # B $ C @ D, which relation between A and D is proved?
questions.explanation: D’s mother is C, whose brother is B; B’s daughter A is D’s maternal-uncle’s daughter.

questions.question: A woman, Nalini, introduces a man: “His daughter is my grandson’s mother.” Nalini’s son and his wife are that grandson’s parents. What is the introduced man to Nalini’s son?
questions.explanation: The daughter is Nalini’s son’s wife; her father is his father-in-law.

questions.question: Eight relatives: A and B are husband and wife; C is their son and D their daughter. E is C’s wife and F is D’s husband. G is C–E’s daughter; H is D–F’s son. Considering only these eight, who has both a daughter and a granddaughter?
questions.explanation: A and B have daughter D and granddaughter G through son C.

questions.question: A written tree shows P (female)–Q (male) as married parents of son R and daughter S. R and wife T have sons U and V. S has daughter W. Which pair has the same paternal grandparents?
questions.explanation: U and V share father R, whose parents are P and Q.

questions.question: Priya is wife of Rohan, who is younger than his brother Sagar. Sagar’s wife Tina is younger than Priya. What is Tina to Priya?
questions.explanation: The husbands’ relative ages control this term: Sagar is Rohan’s elder brother, so Tina is Priya’s elder co-sister-in-law.

questions.question: X : Y means X is Y’s father; X ; Y means X is Y’s sister; X / Y means X is Y’s wife. Which expression makes C the mother of A while also showing A has a brother B? B is explicitly male. For every married couple, the children shown are children of both spouses.
questions.explanation: C is D’s wife and D is A’s father; A is B’s sister and B is explicitly male, so B is her brother.

questions.question: Seven relatives include 2 proved males, 3 proved females and 2 people whose genders are unrestricted. What is the largest possible excess of females over males?
questions.explanation: Make both unknowns female: 5 females minus 2 males gives an excess of 3.

questions.question: A is B’s daughter; B is C’s son. Which extra fact is enough to decide whether C is A’s paternal grandfather or paternal grandmother?
questions.explanation: C is already on A’s paternal side; wife fixes C as female, hence paternal grandmother.

questions.question: A is the mother of B. C is B’s father. D is C’s brother. Which statement is NOT implied, without any marriage information?
questions.explanation: Parenthood does not itself state a marriage; D’s paternal-uncle link and both parental genders are established.

questions.question: A woman, Tanvi, points to a girl: “Her father’s only sister is my mother.” Which statement locates Tanvi relative to the girl?

options.label: C
options.text: Tanvi is the girl’s maternal-aunt’s daughter

options.label: D
options.text: Tanvi is the girl’s paternal-aunt’s daughter

questions.explanation: Tanvi’s mother is the girl’s father’s sister, so Tanvi is the paternal-aunt’s daughter.

questions.question: Let X % Y mean X is Y’s mother, X @ Y mean X is Y’s husband, and X # Y mean X is Y’s brother. Assume husband and wife are male and female respectively. Assess A % B @ C # D.
questions.explanation: B @ C makes C a wife, hence female, but C # D makes C a brother, hence male; the expression conflicts internally.

questions.question: A woman, Roshni, has a brother Vivek. Vivek’s daughter is Yamini. Yamini’s brother Zubin is father of a girl Aanya. What is Roshni to Zubin?
questions.explanation: Zubin and Yamini share father Vivek; Vivek’s sister Roshni is Zubin’s paternal aunt.
